notes: French receipt (Paris) — item prices (5.80/5.80/5.40) are VAT-inclusive (standard EU practice), and 'TOTAL EURO 17.00' already includes the VAT shown separately as 'Dont TVA 10% = 1.55' (VAT-of-which, not additive). So items+tax (18.55) will NOT equal receiptTotal (17.00) by construction — an inclusive- vs exclusive-tax convention mismatch, not an extraction error. SquadPay's extraction prompt assumes additive/exclusive tax, so this is a deliberately included, genuinely difficult locale case. Image is low resolution (small thumbnail). Currency: EUR, not INR/USD. Source: ExpressExpense Sample Receipt Dataset (MIT).
